jess: Quick check — Sundial (open-source 4B) is slated for catalog inclusion next Tue. Need final license signoff + perf profile. Owners: @maya for perf, @lee for license, @arjun for infra. Anyone blocked?

maya: Ran a few passes today — microbench (512 ctx) on A100: p95 ~120ms/token with q4_0 but long-prompt hallucination tests are noisy. I pushed raw runs + notebook in PR #812.

sam: Legal side — @lee flagged a dependency with a weird clause. Lee, can you confirm compatibility with our redistribution policy or do we need to swap libs?

lee: Confirmed, it's "libfoo" with an advertising-like clause (not plain MIT). Escalated to OSS counsel; waiting on clear guidance, ETA EOD tomorrow.

arjun: Infra: we can host a dedicated canary pool next Wed if perf is tuned. Need the model artifact named like `sundial-4b-q4_0` (artifact + manifest). Also need quant kernels in runtime.

jess: Thanks — @maya can you upload the perf CSV and the hallucination eval set to /mnt/models/sundial and ping here? Also PR #812 needs review @sam.

maya: Uploading now. One caveat: KV-cache memory growth observed when seq > 4k on current runtime; I'm attaching trace logs in the upload and opening an issue.

sam: Will review #812 tonight. If legal clears, I'll cut canary config and schedule a 2-hour window for canary.

deploy-bot: canary job template `canary-schema/v2` created for sundial (owner: eng-ml).

jess: Milestone check: license signoff (lee) — EOD+1; perf remediation (maya) — EOD; infra canary config (arjun) — Wed 10:00; product rollout decision — Thurs. If anything slips, call it out here.

arjun: One infra dep outstanding: runtime quant kernels. @nora-runtime can you confirm pipeline + CI for q4 kernels?

nora-runtime: Pinged runtime team — kernels ready but need CI regression run against our perf suite. Can run tomorrow morning; should be quick.

maya: Good — I'll re-run perf after CI and expect ~15-25% p95 improvement based on local diff.

jess: Great. Action items: lee (license), maya (perf + upload), nora-runtime (CI kernels), arjun (canary config), sam (PR review). Adding notes to the project board. Ping here if anything changes. :thumbsup:
